questions.stem: An 82 year old woman has a stage 2 pressure ulcer on her right heel. Over 3 days the skin around it has become red, warm and swollen, with yellow discharge and a bad smell. She feels unwell. Her temperature is 38.1°C, pulse rate 98 bpm and BP 132/76 mmHg. Investigations are shown.

questions.stem: An 81 year old man is admitted with a fractured neck of femur. He is thin, has a poor appetite, is incontinent of urine and will be bedbound after surgery. The admitting nurse wants to score his risk of developing pressure ulcers, in line with NICE CG179. His temperature is 36.8°C.

questions.stem: A 57 year old man with tetraplegia has a stage 4 pressure ulcer over his right ischial tuberosity. Bone has been visible for 2 months and the ulcer is not healing.
